summary.btc_p2_rule: at least one PATH target must reach STRONG_SIGNAL (contract section 14)
summary.selection_bias_warning: 2 learned models x 14 PATH targets = 28 comparisons, and a target's verdict takes the better model. Under the null, the best of 28 noisy estimates looks better than any single one of them. The fold and year consistency conditions (S6, S7) exist to make that harder, but they do not remove it; only forward shadow does.
